/* Local normalization only: no network, no storage, no credential logging. */
function normalizeCookieInput(input) {
  let value=input;
  for (let depth=0;depth<6;depth++) {
    if (typeof value==='string') {
      value=value.replace(/^\uFEFF/,'').trim();
      if (!value) throw new Error('COOKIE_EMPTY');
      if (/^[\[{"]/.test(value)) {
        try { value=JSON.parse(value); continue; } catch (_) { throw new Error('COOKIE_FORMAT'); }
      }
      const header=value.match(/(?:^|\r?\n)Cookie:\s*([^\r\n]+)/i);
      if (header) value=header[1].trim();
      if (/[\r\n]/.test(value)) throw new Error('COOKIE_FORMAT');
      const pairs=parseCookiePairs(value);
      if (!pairs._m_h5_tk) throw new Error('COOKIE_TOKEN_MISSING');
      return value;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if(value.length!==1) throw new Error('COOKIE_ACCOUNT_SELECTION');
      value=value[0];continue;
    }
    if(value && typeof value==='object') {
      if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value,'cookie')) {value=value.cookie;continue;}
      const keys=Object.keys(value);
      if(keys.length!==1) throw new Error('COOKIE_ACCOUNT_SELECTION');
      if(['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(keys[0])) throw new Error('COOKIE_FORMAT');
      value=value[keys[0]];continue;
    }
    throw new Error('COOKIE_FORMAT');
  }
  throw new Error('COOKIE_FORMAT');
}
function parseCookiePairs(cookie) {
  const pairs=Object.create(null);
  for(const segment of cookie.split(';')) {
    const index=segment.indexOf('=');
    if(index<1) continue;
    const key=segment.slice(0,index).trim();
    if(key) pairs[key]=segment.slice(index+1).trim();
  }
  return pairs;
}
function mergeRefreshedCookie(cookie,updates) {
  const pairs=parseCookiePairs(cookie);
  for(const key of ['_m_h5_tk','_m_h5_tk_enc']) {
    if(typeof updates[key]==='string' && updates[key]) pairs[key]=updates[key];
  }
  return Object.keys(pairs).map(key=>key+'='+pairs[key]).join('; ')+';';
}
function cookieErrorMessage(error) {
  const code=error && error.message;
  if(code==='COOKIE_EMPTY') return '当前账号的 Cookie 为空，请重新添加账号。';
  if(code==='COOKIE_TOKEN_MISSING') return '当前 Cookie 缺少 _m_h5_tk，请重新抓取并更新该账号。';
  if(code==='COOKIE_ACCOUNT_SELECTION') return '当前输入包含多个账号或未选定账号，请先选择一个账号运行。';
  if(code==='SCRIPT_RESPONSE_FORMAT') return '任务脚本没有返回有效请求数据，请稍后重新运行。';
  return 'Cookie 数据格式无法识别，请重新选择或更新账号。';
}
